Did you know?
Mattresses are made up almost entirely
of recyclable materials. Once
disassembled, more than 75 percent of
mattress components can be recycled.
By reducing disposal, the waste bans
also help us capture valuable resources,
save energy, reduce greenhouse gas
emissions, and lessen our reliance on
landfills and incinerators.
